title: Discriminate documented F exceptions, clock consumption, direction and page continuity
status_at_registration: preregistered before real source candidate execution
rationale: Attempt1 produced no frequency-alignment leads for its registered no-skip prime clock branches. Known LP1 DIVINITY and LP2/56 offer exact reference tests of exception semantics before extending any unknown-page hypothesis.
preexecution_correction: Before any real source candidate execution, the Attempt1 rationale wording was corrected to describe absence of frequency leads rather than exact exclusion; all H001 criteria, parameters and budget are unchanged.
scope: Known-page mechanism discrimination only; no new unsolved-page candidates, no dictionary or skip-mask search.

sources.role: Ciphertext preserving source separators; literal percent sections 2 and 3 are LP1/03 and LP1/04.
Independent expected rune construction from source Plaintext and input word rune counts; source key and skips.
Independent expected rune construction, complete combined source tool input and continuation instruction.
LP2/56 independent Plaintext and fixed prime-minus-one source.
Independent source-reported DIVINITY key indices and plaintext F exception wording.

arithmetic.domain: rune ordinal indices 0..28, not GP prime values or Latin letters
arithmetic.key_source_wording: reverse Vigenere cipher; key divinity; continuous chunk adding to end of page 3
arithmetic.direction_interpretation: Primary interpretation is P=(C-K[t mod8]) mod29; source phrase does not alone establish algebraic direction, so P=(C+K[t mod8]) mod29 is a fixed comparison.
arithmetic.prime_delta: prime[t]-1 with zero-based t, prime[0]=2; offset=0 and shift=1
arithmetic.literals: Every non-rune codepoint is preserved and consumes no clock in H001.
arithmetic.page_reset: Reset only key clock to zero before each page; skip coordinates remain global rune ordinals.
arithmetic.step_clock: clock_index is the clock before handling the rune; delta is zero at every selected skip; consumed records actual advancement.

LP1_combined.input: Exact sentence in source04 Tool block; 638 codepoints and 515 runes; source03 singleline plus one ASCII space plus source04 singleline.
LP1_combined.coordinate_system: One-based Unicode codepoints, including ASCII spaces; all selected glyphs must be F before running.

LP2_56.coordinate_system: Zero-based Unicode codepoint in stripped source73 singleline, including hash and spaces; distinct from source03/04 convention.

policies.none: Transform every rune and advance clock once per rune.
policies.specified_free: Keep source-selected exceptions unchanged and do not advance clock there.
policies.specified_consume: Keep source-selected exceptions unchanged but advance clock there.
policies.all_cipher_f_free: Keep every input ciphertext index0 unchanged and do not advance clock there.

acceptance.primary: Subtract + specified_free + continuous must equal independently constructed expected sequence on every rune of each applicable page.
acceptance.all_configurations: Record exact equality, count and first mismatch, all step arithmetic, preserved literal layout, and independent forward reconstruction using each frozen delta/mask. Do not reconstruct inverse by reselecting F from decrypted output.
acceptance.comparisons: No comparison is prelabelled negative; equivalent transformations may coincide and must be reported as such.
acceptance.expected_source: Use Plaintext sections with bracket alternatives and unique segmentation by cipher word rune counts. Never cleaned plaintext, LLM reconstruction, spelling correction or transform output.
acceptance.diagnostic_if_primary_exact: Compare independently expected plaintext index0 positions with prescribed skip set and independently encrypt expected runes using plaintext-F-driven free skips. Report mask equality and exact ciphertext reconstruction per source/page; do not generalize to all unknown pages.
acceptance.statistics: Exact reference comparison only; no language scoring or statistical significance selected from these configurations.
acceptance.outcomes: passed, negative, error, timeout and inconclusive remain distinct. Failure excludes only the tested parameters, source and criterion.

limits: Independent computation path is not independent historical provenance; source repositories may share ancestry.
Original image viewing confirms layout, not an independent person-by-person glyph audit.
A recovered known page is a regression result, not a new Liber Primus solution.
No learned exception-mask selector for unknown ciphertext is established by this test.
